visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: deposit Changes the Wrong Variable
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After depositing 50 into an account with 100, getBalance should print 150, but it prints 100.

solution.explanation: The money is kept in the closure variable balance. this.balance creates a different property on the returned object, which getBalance never reads, so the deposit is lost. Use the closure variable directly.
